aspect: Humour is the delivery mechanism and the defence
description: The content is deniable because it was a joke, and the joke format obliges a response from the target in real time, in public, with no time to think.
energy_note: Attacked and required to smile, simultaneously.

aspect: Sue calls the retreat a microassault
description: Telling a racist or sexist joke and then saying 'I was just joking' appears in the taxonomy as a conscious, explicit discriminatory act - not an ambiguous one.
energy_note: The 'only joking' is part of the act, not a retraction.

description: If it is ever raised later, the fact that the target laughed at the time will be produced, and will be treated as evidence they did not mind.
energy_note: Your own laugh, used as a statement against you.

description: The director does the accent. It is his third time and the room laughs. She laughs too, because there are eleven people watching and he approves her leave. In the taxi home she cannot work out why she feels ashamed rather than angry.
energy_note: Ashamed, rather than angry, and not sure why.
